rendered: In the BatPaC comparison (Fig. 2[1]), Co-free cathodes give a total pack cost of $8500[2], against $10 000[3] for NCA, so the total pack cost is lower by $1500[4]. The material cost is $3500[5] versus $5000[6] for NCA, so the material cost is lower by $1500[7]. Both differences are the same, so the Co-free pack is cheaper by the same amount on each measure.
